title: Can Native Safety Travel? Reusing Safety Pretraining Across Models via On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27555v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety pretraining has emerged as a promising paradigm for embedding safety deeply into a model during pretraining, yielding robustness to subsequent fine-tuning that conventional safety post-training often lacks. We refer to this safety acquired during model pretraining as native safety. Yet native safety is expensive to acquire, confined to the model in which it was pretrained, and often accompanied by lower general utility. In this work, we rethink the practical value of safety-pretrained models and introduce, for the first time, the native safety reuse problem: Can native safety be transferred from a specialized, potentially smaller, safety-pretrained "teacher" to standard-pretrained "students," enabling them to inherit its robustness while preserving their general utility? translated_title: 原生安全性能否迁移？通过在线策略蒸馏实现跨模型的安全预训练复用
translated_abstract: 安全预训练已成为一种有前景的范式，它能在预训练阶段将安全性深度融入模型之中，从而获得对后续微调的鲁棒性，而这种鲁棒性是传统安全后训练往往缺乏的。我们将这种在模型预训练期间习得的安全性称为“原生安全性”。然而，原生安全性获取成本高昂，仅局限于其被预训练的那个模型，并且常常伴随着较低的通用能力。在这项工作中，我们重新思考了安全预训练模型的实际价值，并首次提出了原生安全性复用问题：原生安全性能否从一个专用的、可能规模更小的安全预训练“教师”模型迁移到标准预训练的“学生”模型，使后者在继承其鲁棒性的同时保留自身的通用能力？我们证明了原生安全性可以通过在线策略蒸馏进行“迁移”：标准预训练的学生模型针对安全预训练提示生成回复，而……
tldr: 本文首次提出“原生安全性复用”问题，并证明通过在线策略蒸馏，可以将安全预训练教师模型的鲁棒安全性迁移给标准预训练的学生模型，使其在保留通用能力的同时继承安全鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces, for the first time, the native safety reuse problem and shows that on-policy distillation can transfer robust native safety from a specialized safety-pretrained teacher model to standard-pretrained student models, enabling them to inherit safety robustness while preserving their general utility.
